# @rnw-community/nestjs-rxjs-redis

> NestJS Redis (ioredis) wrapper for RxJS streams: `Observable`-returning commands and pipeable save / load / remove /
> cache operators. Peers: `@nestjs/common`, `@nestjs-modules/ioredis`, `ioredis`, `rxjs`.

## Landing

- [readme.md](readme.md): Module configuration, basic command examples, and operator examples.

## Guides

- [Basic operations](readme.md#basic-operations): `set$`, `get$`, `del$`, and `mget$` usage.
- [Operators](readme.md#nestjsrxjsredisservice): Pipeable save, load, remove, and load-or-prepare caching operators.

## API reference

- [`NestJSRxJSRedisModule`](readme.md#nestjsrxjsredismodule): Module whose `forRootAsync(options)` registers the ioredis connection and a global `NestJSRxJSRedisService`.
- [`NestJSRxJSRedisService`](readme.md#nestjsrxjsredisservice): Service with `set$` / `get$` / `del$` / `ttl$` / `expire$` / `incr$` / `mget$` commands and `save` / `load` / `remove` / `cache` operators.

## Architecture & conventions

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/rnw-community/blob/master/packages/nestjs-rxjs-redis/AGENTS.md): Source layout, implementation patterns, dependencies, and coverage.
